The theorem is proved and `/work/putnam_2020_b4.lean` compiles with no errors and no `sorry` warning. The only remaining messages are two unused-variable linter warnings from my helper lemmas.

The proof follows the standard cyclic-shift argument, which gives M(n) = 1/(2n) for every n ≥ 1, so M(2020) = 1/4040.

- **Rotation identity:** for a walk s in V_N (N = 2n), the cyclic rotation `rot N k s` has `q = S / 3^{s(k mod N)}`, where S = Σ_{i<N} 3^{s i}. So Σ_k 1/q(rot_k s) = 1 for each s.
- **Bijection:** each rotation permutes V_N, so Σ_v 1/q(v) = |V_N| / N.
- **Finiteness:** V_N is finite (injects into a bounded box), so the tsum and `ncard` reduce to finite sums.

I added helper definitions and lemmas above the theorem (`Vs`, `rot`, `qf`, and several lemmas), plus a `general` lemma for arbitrary n. The theorem statement, docstring, and `putnam_2020_b4_solution` are unchanged; only `sorry` was replaced by the proof.
